arm_summary.hypothesis: Club strength is league strength plus a shrunk club deviation; goals are Poisson with a low-score correction.

arm_summary.name: elo_xleague
arm_summary.hypothesis: A single rating per club, updated match by match, is enough.

arm_summary.name: hier_bayes
arm_summary.hypothesis: Club ratings are drawn from league-level distributions; integrating over rating uncertainty beats conditioning on its mode, especially for clubs with few observed matches.

arm_summary.name: gbm

arm_summary.name: gnn
